fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestGates with a fake clock, a fake CI status and a fixture daemon-run history file (the format tools/release defines and reads) covers each gate passing and failing, a commit missing from the history failing the soak gate, and the severe skip
fields.statement: tools/release check reports each gate for the candidate commit with why it passes or fails: CI green on the commit; the root daemon first ran the commit at least 24h ago and no bug request was filed since; no change set serving the finished milestone in flight and no question blocking one; a patch is at most one per 24h unless a severe: fix is in it, which skips the soak and the batching but never CI
